scope: Current worktree with concurrent Sol telemetry changes; no application source modified by this audit

shadowProbe.procedure: Disable adaptive decisions, call setShadows(false), count mesh castShadow flags, teleport to (1500,-640), wait nine seconds, recount
shadowProbe.caveat: Caster flags prove shadow-off enforcement failure, not the number of submitted shadow draws

lakeProbe.points: For i in [0,10000), lake=lakes[i%7], x=lake.x+sin(i*1.618)*footprint*1.3, z=lake.z+cos(i*2.414)*footprint*1.3
lakeProbe.procedure: Call real isPointInLake synchronously, temporarily replacing registry.entries.values only inside the isolated comparison with a generator over byKind lake IDs; restore in finally, no animation frame may run during substitution
lakeProbe.caveat: Enumeration-only microbenchmark with real polygon tests, not a whole-game speedup claim

workerProbe.procedure: Blob module worker imports existing /src/worldgen/index.js via absolute same-origin URL, sets seed, calls queryRegion, posts structured-cloned result; main thread compares JSON.stringify output then terminates worker
workerProbe.caveat: Proves no-build pure planning feasibility, not throughput improvement or correctness of asynchronous mesh/registry commits

routeCaveats: CPU profiler and one-second snapshots were active; results are diagnostic, not clean performance acceptance runs
God mode prevented penalties but collisions still changed the route; boost held for eighteen seconds
Renderer DPR was manually halved without repairing composer dimensions; explicit dimensions are recorded
Opening parked windows include unfinished horizon work and are not pure steady-state baselines
Low-tier positions phase was overwritten by perfSnapshot.phase; frame phases remain correct and positions retain timestamps
Six lifecycle transitions are a short soak and do not establish a memory plateau or prove a leak
Concurrent work on the same Mac means exclusive CPU/GPU availability was not guaranteed
